Fresh Catch

Today’s catch, priced by the pound. Pick your fish, tell us how you want it, and we’ll weigh and cook it for pickup.

How by-the-pound works

  1. 1Choose your fish and an estimated weight. About 1 lb of whole fish per person [OWNER CONFIRM].
  2. 2Pay the estimate online. Market price plus the cooking charge, by the pound.
  3. 3We weigh it at the counter. Your final price matches the actual weight.
